text:
He was that madman, sublime fool…
that forgotten Icarus climbing the skies,
that lost Phaethon beneath the divine bolt,
the fair wounded Attis whom Cybele revives!

The augur examined the victim’s side,
the earth grew drunk on that precious blood…
The dazed cosmos hung upon its axes,
and Olympus wavered for an instant toward the abyss.

“Tell me!” Caesar cried to Jupiter Ammon,
who is this new god who has mastered the earth?
And if no god, is he at least a demon…?

But the summoned oracle fell forever silent;
only one in the world could explain the mystery:
he who gave his soul to the children of clay.

translation.title: He Was That Madman, Sublime Fool
translation.editorial_note: Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
